_about: Design guideline rules used for decision making. Each rule cites its source document, section and page. Ranges are checked against NbS elements; breaches are reported with the citation. Edit or extend this file as more guideline chapters are added.

sources.HC-4.10: Habitat Collective guidelines, 4.10 Constructed Wetlands (D2). Refs: ITRC 2003; NJDEP BMP Manual ch.10.4 (2021); UN-HABITAT Constructed Wetlands Manual (2008).
sources.HC-4.11: Habitat Collective guidelines, 4.11 Edge Engineering (D2). Refs incl. VA DEQ Spec 9 Bioretention (2011); City of Toronto GI ROW manual (2021); US EPA 841-B-13-001.
sources.HC-4.12: Habitat Collective guidelines, 4.12 In-line SWD Treatment (D2). Refs incl. NCDEQ D-3; Oldcastle NSBB; RTI/Geosyntec for US EPA (2015).

rules.note: 3:1 to 4:1 preferred; 3:1 maximum steepness. Also HC-4.10 berms 3:1 to 4:1.
Below 0.5 % stagnation; above 4 % needs structural drop gradients. Project brief uses 1-4 % for bioswales.
Slopes above 4 % require structural drop gradients (check dams / step-down weirs).
Capping temporary edge ponding to 150-300 mm limits mosquito breeding and meets urban safety.
600-1000 mm engineered sandy loam / coarse sand / topsoil over gravel; clay < 5 %.
Infiltration capacity > 13 mm/hr. Slower native soil needs an underdrain (HC 4.2 p.16, 23; HC 4.7 p.16).
Target velocity <= 0.5-1.0 m/s to prevent scour and allow settling.
Check dams every 10-15 m along channels. Also HC-4.12 gabion check dams in series at 10-15 m.
Ponding persisting > 48 h indicates clogged filter media.
>= 75 mm diameter to avoid clogging; undersized orifices are the most common cause of failure.
Sediment forebay 10-15 % of total volume (HC-4.12 gives ~10 %, min 0.5-1 m deep pit).
Minimum 300 mm freeboard; berm height = water depth + 25 mm/yr sediment allowance + freeboard.
Berm must contain the 1-in-25-year storm without overtopping (NRCS CPS 656).
Stormwater runoff 24-72 h; HRT = volume x porosity / daily flow. Minimum 2 days to limit mosquito breeding.
Surface flow 3:1-5:1 preferred, 1:1 regulatory minimum, avoid > 10:1.
NJDEP minimum 1:1; ratios above 10:1 starve the far end of flow.
Surface flow shallow zone 0.1-0.6 m; deep pool 0.6-1.5 m.
Deep pool 1.0-2.5 m for retention ponds, 0.6-1.5 m for open wetlands (HC-4.10).
Minimum catchment 25 acres (~10.1 ha) for pond/marsh type, 10 acres (~4.0 ha) for extended detention; smaller catchments risk under-loading.
Minimum 2 cells, 3 or more preferred.
Lining required where native soil k > 1e-6 m/s (3.6 mm/hr) for permanent pools: clay >= 300 mm at k <= 1e-9 m/s or 0.5-2.0 mm HDPE/EPDM.

context_notes.text: Constructed wetland unit size min. 40-60 m x 10-15 m; zones: sedimentation pond 20 %, deepwater inlet 10 %, shallow vegetated zone 70 % of wetland area.
Reported performance: peak flow reduction up to 23 %, 40-50 % removal of TN, TP, TSS. Literature figures, not used in SWMM results.
In-line green systems need drains >= 1.5-2 m wide and > 1.5 m deep and a consistent base flow; bypass for monsoon peaks is mandatory.
Confirm sewage mixing in drains before specifying biological systems; prioritise NSBBs / hydrodynamic separators if present.
